description: Run up to 10 calls of other tools in one request and get all results back together, in order. Each entry is {name, arguments} exactly as for a single call; each result carries its own signature block, so every one verifies on its own. The batch call itself is free: every entry counts as one call against the daily limit. A failed entry does not stop the others (it comes back with an error), except that once the daily limit is reached or the batch has run for about 20 seconds, the entries after that point are not run and not counted: the reply says so for each, so send them again. A batch cannot contain a batch. Entries run one after another, in order, and none sees the output of another.
